# Score Fixtures

Reference MusicXML (`.xml`/`.mxl`) and rendered-score files used to establish
evidence before parser implementation live here. Their presence does not mean
that score parsing has been implemented.

## Fixture Index

| ID | Sample | Files | DEV-003 status | Evidence |
|----|--------|-------|----------------|----------|
| TMM-REF-CANDIDATE-001 | Hot Cross Buns | Compressed MusicXML and PDF | Parts 1-4 complete; approved authoritative ground truth; no musical discrepancy found; DEV-003 DONE | [Sample README](TMM-REF-CANDIDATE-001-Hot-Cross-Buns/README.md) |

The stable identifier retains `CANDIDATE`, but the sample now has an
approved authoritative ground-truth record. DEV-003 is DONE; the identifier
is preserved because stable identifiers are not renamed after creation.
